dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Greetings! My name is Huai'an, and I am the innkeeper. I would encourage you to stay here for a few days, but it seems that you have pressing matters to attend to...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I fear the recent meteorites are bad omens. You will fare better if you steer well clear of them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: What a brilliant strategy... Your card skills are really superb.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Thanks for the game. Try again next time you've got time.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: There are quite a few good players in this game. This is a lesson learned.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: This victory did not come easily. You're not so bad at cards yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Phew, that was close. I doubt I'll be this lucky this next time!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Well played! You're as good at cards as you are at martial arts!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hello! I am Huai'an, innkeeper of the Wangshu Inn. Are you in need of a meal, or a room for the night?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Thanks to yourself and all our dear guests, business has been going reasonably well. We will get by.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Haha, it's getting livelier again.

choices.text: What can you tell me about the rumors?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: If you mean someone's been bad-mouthing the Wangshu Inn, don't believe a word of what you hear.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: But if you just wanted to get the lowdown about what's been going on recently...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: The Fatui's presence in Liyue Harbor has been growing recently. It looks like trouble is brewing.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Now it's your turn! Any interesting stories to share with me?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: This is Richie! We called him that hoping it would bring us good luck.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: He's a good boy, aren't you Richie? He doesn't make a mess and he's good with the guests.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's that over there? She doesn't look like she's from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Ah yes, that would be my wife. She moved from Mondstadt to marry me.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: When I was a child we used to sing this nursery rhyme about Liyue women: "Half the girls marry to a winery town, the other half sail to a faraway land."

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Oh, how the tables have turned... I feel quite proud to have broken the mold! Hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Goldet is very sharp. She picks up on all these little details about people and figures out their backgrounds.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Alright, goodbye. Stop in for a chat anytime! You're always welcome at the Wangshu Inn.
